changeLog: Version 1.3.1 - NEW FOLLOW TAB: guided, checkpoint-by-checkpoint navigation along any route recorded in the Tracker. A steering arrow relative to the way you are facing, distance and bearing to the next checkpoint in true, magnetic, mils and BD grid, the turn coming after it, how far off the line you are and which way to correct, plus the GR and map sheet of the point you are heading for. Spoken turn cues let you navigate eyes-up, an off-route alarm steers you back onto the line, and the path you actually walked can be saved as a new route for the after-action record. Works with your offline AO maps and keeps the screen awake while guiding. FOLLOW and the Pro Tracker now run together on one shared GPS engine: each gets the fix rate it needs and the status notification always shows what is really running. Night Vision (red light) now keeps the steering arrow, status chip and position marker bright and readable. FOLLOW label available in English and Bangla. Hardening: double-tap protection on route start, correct first-leg guidance (TO ROUTE START), and an updated server identity for place search. The instl will download the bdmgrcp file inside the itrl folder. User needs to instl that downloaded bdmgrcp.apk file from the downloaded itrl folder. As it is a BD local product, user needs to give, auth all the access, permission to instl the new version bdmgrcp.apk. This will update the present version. 16 Oct 2026.
